owner_posts.post_text:
Building the Future of Wildlife Conservation: Specialized Zoo Construction by HKS

Zoo construction isn't standard brick-and-mortar development. It sits at a highly complex intersection of specialized structural engineering, strict biosecurity, animal welfare, and visitor safety.

At HKS Designer & Consultant International Co. Ltd., our dedicated Construction Division bridges the gap between visionary habitat concepts and concrete structural reality. We handle the heavy lifting to ensure that every facility is safe, durable, and highly functional.

What we deliver:
Heavy-Duty Containment: Engineering secure barriers tailored to specific species behavior and strength.
Immersive Enclosures & Aviaries: Building naturalistic spaces that foster natural animal behaviors while ensuring easy maintenance.
Visitor & Keeper Infrastructure: Constructing safe viewing decks, holding areas, and pathways that manage guest flow seamlessly.

From safari parks and public zoos to eco-resorts and conservation centers across Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and India, we build environments where animals thrive and people safely connect with nature.

Let’s build your next wildlife project to international standards.

We specialize in custom metal art, designer grills in wrought iron, cast iron, mild steel and stainless steel, and architectural metal installations fabricated in-house. From sculptural metal features and façade elements to bespoke console tables, lighting and precision metal detailing, each project is executed from our Darukhana workshop and installed across South Mumbai with controlled finishing and site alignment.
